“李青山，你一个村子里的二流子，知道什么？上过山吗？打过猎吗？”

“五百斤的野猪，你见过吗？”

“不知道就别瞎说，这就是五百斤野猪的心，刚刚才割下来的，肉已经拉出村卖了，要是不信就去打听打听，是不是五百斤野猪肉。”

王坤冷哼一声，脸上满是对李青山反驳的不屑道。

“野猪上了五百斤后，心脏外面会分泌一层黄色宛若丝线一般的条纹，叫肉黄藤，在强光下是隐约可见的，一颗心脏上大概也就是两三条左右，也就是因为这两三条金线一样的条纹，才能让五百斤野猪的心成为药引，有了药用价值。”

“你自己看看，你这猪心上可有这东西？”

李青山笑道。

五百斤以上野猪心上的这个东西，叫做肉黄藤，在医书上也比较少见，而且只有死了三天之内的肉黄藤有用，所以采取极其困难，这也就导致这一味中药极少会被开出来。

但是效果好。

李青山话音落下，赵山杏目光朝着王坤望了过去，眼神中闪过一抹质疑之色。

“肉黄藤？”

“李青山，你小子胡说什么？哪有这种东西？”

“这就是五百斤野猪的心脏，你要是不信，咱们就去问问买肉的，板车上面有没有五百多斤的野猪肉。”

王坤冷哼一声，气哼哼道。

“山杏，给你爹开药方子的这个大夫，肯定是知道肉黄藤的，你要是不信的话，就去再寻那大夫去问问，五百斤以上野猪的心上是不是有肉黄藤，是不是只有肉黄藤才能做药引！”

“至于班车上五百斤的野猪肉，谁知道你们打了一头野猪还是两头野猪？”

“万一是打了两头三百斤的野猪，其中一头野猪的头和四条腿，下水全部拿走，只留下肉，肯定是有五百斤的。”

李青山轻笑一声，早已看穿了王坤道。

因为这野猪的心，肯定不是五百斤野猪的。

“好，我这就去问！”

赵山杏点头应下，这毕竟不是小事情，若是用了没有疗效，非但会搭上自己的身子。

按照那药方抓的药，也是价格不菲。

按照自己家中的情况，很难再有钱去抓第二次的药了。

所以。

这件事情必须要慎重，该去问的一定要去问，不能偷懒。

“山杏？”

“你这是不信任我？”

“好，既然不信任我，那我也没必要在这里继续待下去了，这野猪心啊！”

“我去喂狗！”

王坤背后冒出一身冷汗，抢过赵山杏手中的野猪心，便气急败坏的离开了。

这要是被山杏坐实了，以后和山杏可就没可能了，山杏说不得什么，也得是自己媳妇。

本打算让山杏陪自己睡一个月的时间，让她怀上自己的种。

只要怀上自己的种，没道理不跟自己结婚，当自己媳妇。

但是这一切，都被李青山这个二流子给破坏了。

这个梁子，是结下了。

“青山，谢谢了！”

赵山杏望着离开的王坤，一切都已经明了，不打自招。

若不是有李青山，自己可就损失大了。

“占山叔救过我的命，这是应该的。”李青山开口道。

“你是怎么知道肉黄藤的？”赵山杏好奇道。

“师父教的！”

“你还有师父教你学医？我怎么不知道？”赵山杏微微一怔，脸上的好奇之色更加浓重了几分。

“我这师父在山上住，不过前一段时间离开了！”

“不知所踪，但是教给我的一身医术却留下来了。”

“对了，那大夫给占山叔开的药方子呢？”

“能不能给我看看？”

李青山问道。

“算了吧！”

“你这个年纪，肯定没有赵大夫的医术高，肯定也看不出啥！”

“对了，今天你揭穿了王坤的诡计，他肯定要记恨在心的，他家也是猎户，以后你上山的时候免不得要碰上，一定小心。”

赵山杏提醒道。

“好吧！”

“大黄，走啦！”

李青山朝着大黄吹了个口哨，背着猎弓，腰间挎着柴刀，绳子，装着粮食的布袋子，背对着赵山杏挥了挥手。

“汪汪汪！”

大黄也对着赵山杏叫了两声后，便匆匆跟上了前面的李青山。

赵占山救过自己的性命。

如今身受重伤，若是不治愈的话，一年之内肯定要咽气！

如今，只有两个办法。

第一个办法，狩猎到五百斤的野猪，当作药引，将赵占山的伤势！

"Li Qingshan, you are a second-rate boy from a village. What do you know? Have you ever been to the mountains? Have you ever hunted?"

"Have you ever seen a five-hundred-pound wild boar?"

"If you don't know, don't lie. This is the heart of a 500-jin wild boar. It was cut off just now. The meat has been sold out of the village. If you don't believe it, go and find out if it is a 500-jin wild boar."

Wang Kun snorted coldly, his face full of disdain for Li Qingshan's retort.

"After a wild boar weighs 500 pounds, a layer of yellow thread-like stripes called yellow vines will be secreted outside the heart. They are vaguely visible under strong light. There are only about two or three stripes on a heart. It is because of these two or three gold-like stripes that the heart of the 500-pound wild boar can become a medicine guide and have medicinal value."

"See for yourself, do you have this in your pig's heart?"

Li Qingshan smiled.

This thing on the heart of a wild boar weighing more than 500 pounds is called yellow vine. It is relatively rare in medical books, and only the yellow vine that has died within three days is useful, so it is extremely difficult to take. This also leads to the fact that this traditional Chinese medicine is rarely prescribed.

But the effect is good.

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, Zhao Shanxing looked towards Wang Kun, with a hint of doubt in his eyes.

"Yellow vine?"

"Li Qingshan, what are you talking about? How can there be such a thing?"

"This is the heart of a five hundred kilogram wild boar. If you don't believe it, let's ask the meat buyer if there is more than five hundred kilograms of wild boar on the cart."

Wang Kun snorted coldly and said angrily.

"Shan Xing, the doctor who prescribed the medicine for your father must know about the yellow vine. If you don't believe it, go find the doctor again and ask if there is a yellow vine in the heart of a wild boar weighing more than 500 kilograms. Is it true that only the yellow vine can be used as a medicine?"

"As for the five hundred kilograms of wild boar on the bus, who knows if you killed one wild boar or two wild boars?"

"If two wild boars weighing 300 kilograms were killed, and the head and four legs of one of the wild boars were taken away, leaving only the meat, it must have weighed 500 kilograms."

Li Qingshan chuckled, having already seen through Wang Kundao.

Because the heart of this wild boar is definitely not that of a 500-jin wild boar.

"Okay, I'll ask right away!"

Zhao Shanxing nodded in agreement. This was not a trivial matter after all. If it had no effect after using it, it would not only harm him.

The medicine taken according to that prescription is also expensive.

According to the situation at home, it is difficult to have money to buy the second medicine.

so.

You must be cautious about this matter, and you must ask what you need to ask, and you cannot be lazy.

"Shan Xing?"

"You don't trust me?"

"Okay, since you don't trust me, there's no need for me to stay here any longer. I have such a wild boar heart!"

"I'm going to feed the dog!"

Wang Kun broke out in a cold sweat, snatched the wild boar heart from Zhao Shanxing's hand, and left angrily.

If this is confirmed by Shan Xing, it will be impossible to be with Shan Xing in the future. Shan Xing can't say anything, she must be his wife.

She originally planned to let Shan Xing sleep with her for a month so that she could become pregnant with her child.

As long as she is pregnant with her own child, there is no reason not to marry her and become her daughter-in-law.

But all this was ruined by Li Qingshan, a second-rate man.

This bridge has been forged.

"Qingshan, thank you!"

Zhao Shanxing looked at Wang Kun who was leaving. Everything was clear and he didn't bring it upon himself.

If it weren't for Li Qingshan, he would have suffered a great loss.

"Uncle Zhanshan saved my life, it's as it should be." Li Qingshan said.

"How do you know about the yellow vine?" Zhao Shanxing asked curiously.

"Master taught me!"

"You still have a master to teach you medicine? Why don't I know?" Zhao Shanxing was slightly startled, and the curiosity on his face became a little more intense.

"My master lives in the mountains, but he left some time ago!"

"I have disappeared, but the medical skills he taught me remain."

"By the way, where is the prescription the doctor prescribed for Uncle Zhanshan?"

"Can you show it to me?"

Li Qingshan asked.

"Forget it!"

"At your age, you are definitely not as good as Dr. Zhao in medical skills, and you definitely can't see anything!"

"By the way, you exposed Wang Kun's trick today. He will definitely bear a grudge. His family is also a hunter. You will inevitably run into him when you go up the mountain in the future, so be careful."

Zhao Shanxing reminded.

"Okay!"

"Dahuang, let's go!"

Li Qingshan whistled towards Dahuang, carrying a hunting bow on his back, a hatchet, a rope, and a cloth bag with grain on his waist, and waved to Zhao Shanxing with his back.

"Woof woof woof!"

After Dahuang also called Zhao Shanxing twice, he hurriedly followed Li Qingshan in front.

Zhao Zhanshan saved his life.

Now he is seriously injured. If he is not cured, he will definitely die within a year!

Today, there are only two ways.

The first way is to hunt down 500 kilograms of wild boar and use it as medicine to treat Zhao Zhanshan’s injuries!
